name: nexus-platform
description: NEXUS — AI-Powered Company Operating Platform for Saudi companies

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @nexus/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @nexus/api" "npm run dev -w @nexus/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nexus/shared && npm run build -w @nexus/api && npm run build -w @nexus/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @nexus/shared && npm run build -w @nexus/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @nexus/shared && npm run build -w @nexus/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @nexus/shared && tsc -p packages/shared --noEmit && tsc -p apps/api --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web --noEmit
